text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Satsuki Sho. Being the 
first leg of the Classic Triple Crown, 
expectations among the spectators ran 
high.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, doubts were raised about Smart 
Falcon entering a turf race when she had 
built her strength competing on dirt.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite putting on a brave front, Smart 
Falcon cannot hide her anxiety. The 
Trainer cheers her on with supportive 
chants.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A special Winning Live for the Classic 
Triple Crown. Aiming for center stage, 
Smart Falcon heads out to the race.
